hero.subtitle: The ultimate full-stack foundation built for extreme flexibility. Powered by an advanced MVC plugin-based architecture, flawlessly merging Go's raw performance with Vue 3's intuitive interaction.

features.title: Built for Complexity
features.subtitle: More than just a framework—we are your business acceleration engine. Every line of code is meticulously crafted for high concurrency and deep extensibility.
features.perfDesc: Powered by Go 1.24, achieving microsecond-level routing and massive concurrency through zero-copy and memory pool optimizations.
features.securityDesc: Built-in physical-level backend isolation combined with Geetest behavior awareness, creating an impregnable firewall for your assets.
features.pluginDesc: Pioneering a hot-pluggable module protocol. Dynamically extend routes, models, and business logic without restarting services.
features.mvcDesc: Following the path of pure code cleanliness. Strict separation of logic and view makes collaboration and maintenance elegant and simple.
features.configDesc: Environment-based scheduling supporting dynamic theme injection, intelligent i18n, and secure admin path stealth mechanisms.
features.deployDesc: Frontend statically compiled into a single binary via Embed. No external dependencies—perfect for cloud-native and private delivery.

adminSettings.smtpHostHint: Use the provider SMTP hostname (usually starts with smtp.). Do not use the webmail URL.
adminSettings.smtpPortHint:
Three common ports:
• 587 (recommended): STARTTLS → turn SSL OFF below
• 465: SSL from the start → turn SSL ON below
• 25: legacy; often blocked by cloud/ISP, avoid
adminSettings.smtpPortPresetHint: Click a button to fill the port and auto-match SSL
adminSettings.smtpUsernameHint: Most providers use the full email as username; some corporate mail uses a separate login ID.
adminSettings.smtpPasswordHint: Gmail / Yandex / QQ / 163 often require SMTP enabled and an app password — not your web login password.
adminSettings.systemEmailAddressHint: Leave empty to use the login email above. Keep it matching the login mailbox or providers may reject/spam it.
adminSettings.smtpSSLHint:
Same as most admin panels — pick by port:
• Port 465 → ON (SSL/TLS from connect)
• Port 587 → OFF (STARTTLS / TLS upgrade after connect)
Both are encrypted; wrong combo causes TLS handshake errors.
adminSettings.smtpSSLPortConflict587: Port is 587 but SSL is ON. Turn SSL off (STARTTLS), or switch to 465.
adminSettings.smtpSSLPortConflict465: Port is 465 but SSL is OFF. Turn SSL on, or switch to 587.
adminSettings.smtpProxyHint: Enable when direct SMTP to Yandex/Gmail fails (e.g. in mainland China). Supports HTTP/SOCKS5 with optional auth. Keep off for direct connect.
adminSettings.smtpProxyUpdateFailed: Failed to update SMTP proxy setting
adminSettings.smtpGuideTitle: Quick cheat sheet (same as mainstream panels)
adminSettings.smtpGuideBody:
Recommended: smtp.xxx.com + port 587 + SSL OFF
Alternative: smtp.xxx.com + port 465 + SSL ON

Examples:
• Yandex: smtp.yandex.com / 587 / SSL off
• Gmail: smtp.gmail.com / 587 / SSL off (app password required)
• QQ Mail: smtp.qq.com / 465 + SSL on, or 587 + SSL off
• 163: smtp.163.com / 465 / SSL on

Fill Test Recipient below and send — if it arrives, you're good.
